The downstream job preserves its supplied input and even allows n06-r06, so the omission originated upstream. The visible upstream normalize function uses an allowed_record_ids list containing n06-r09 instead of n06-r06, causing n06-r06 to be silently filtered out before the handoff.

Job 2 input needs and evidence_sources contain n06-r01, n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r07, and n06-r08, but not n06-r06.
Upstream normalize source defines allowed_record_ids = ['n06-r01','n06-r02','n06-r03','n06-r04','n06-r05','n06-r09','n06-r07','n06-r08'] and filters normalized_df by that list.
Downstream map_coverage source allows n06-r06 in its allowed_record_ids, indicating Job 2 would not have filtered n06-r06 if it had been handed off.
